verdict.rationale: Kong supports open-format data portability primarily via decK (declarative YAML/JSON config export/import for Gateway) and Insomnia's export to OpenAPI/Postman/HAR/cURL formats, plus explicit 'export a design document for version control' workflows and no-vendor-lock-in declarative deployment claims. However, this evidence centers on config/API-spec/collection data, not a full guarantee that all platform data (analytics, catalog entries, MCP/AI Gateway state) is exportable in open formats. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of exporting Konnect/AI Gateway analytics, catalog, and full platform state in open formats, plus independent confirmation of a frictionless full-data exit.
